Findings.quoted_evidence:
pub proof fn step_size(tracked &self, id: ListId) -> (res: nat)
        requires
            self.inv(),
            self.lists.dom().contains(id),
        ensures
            res == self.lists[id].list.len(),
Findings.problem: The exact result is expressed as an equality in ensures. The same pattern appears in step_is_empty, step_contains, step_current_meta and step_as_list.
Findings.key_premise: step_size returns a nat exactly equal to self.lists[id].list.len().
Findings.suggestion: Use returns self.lists[id].list.len() and remove its result binder; use type-matched returns expressions for the other exact results, retaining independent postconditions.

Findings.problem: An explicit ghost local repeats the mode already implied by the proof body; many step_* proof bodies repeat this pattern.
Findings.key_premise: n is an ordinary mathematical local in a proof fn, not an executable boundary.
Findings.suggestion: Use let n in proof bodies for mathematical locals, while retaining tracked binders for ownership values.
